interfaces.decision: Use the three approved milestone objectives and exit criteria and one issue per planned implementation task; include requirement IDs, dependencies, and approved artifact digests.
Backend owns compose.yaml and creates the frontend service boundary during the platform task; Frontend owns only frontend/** and must not edit compose.yaml directly.

interfaces.producer: signup, login, logout, current-user, cookie-session, and CSRF contract
interfaces.decision: Server owns identity, normalization, session state, rotation, expiry, logout invalidation, and CSRF enforcement; the browser sends credentials and safe bounded fields only.

rulings: Ruling: compose.yaml has one owner, backend-engineer-auth. This resolves the approved plan's overlapping backend create/frontend modify entries against the readiness no-overlap constraint. Cost if wrong: frontend integration may require a governed backend remediation attempt.
